scope: 112 frozen-model rollouts from clamped rest. Each extra load starts at 2 s, after a shared initial load. The clips use the 6 m/s² load setting.
selection: All clips for each material show the lowest common seed, with the same geometry, first load and camera.
paired_response_metric: RMS of predicted added motion minus Newton added motion, divided by RMS of Newton added motion. Added motion compares otherwise identical driven and reference trajectories after the first changed control.
